bio: Tucked away in the alleys of the small Dalmatian town of Trogir, hidden very near the bridge connecting the island to the mainland, this delightful spot offers a distinctly Mediterranean cuisine in an authentic setting, characterized by typical Dalmatian stone. The food is flavorful and based on local seafood, with occasional nods to Italian flavors, such as truffle pasta or a fresh burrata appetizer. At lunch, three budget-friendly set menus are available, alongside a few à la carte entrées. In the evening, the atmosphere is particularly pleasant, especially in the small courtyard overlooking the passageway. To start your meal on the right note, we recommend a glass of Extra Brut Tomac. Some rooms are also available on the upper floors....
